summary: Every campus page whose HubSpot Program type is Open or Announced shows a visible Book a Call (desktop, tablet, mobile) linking to that campus's own HubSpot call_scheduling_link; a hidden or missing Book a Call, or a link other than the Program's call_scheduling_link, is a finding on Open and Announced pages. Supersedes the unmerged 2026-10-06 no-Book-a-Call-while-Announced proposal (PR 81) and retires the 2026-09-24 Lexington (boston-suburbs) hidden exception. Pre-Announcement unchanged (no booking). If HubSpot has no call_scheduling_link the ask goes to the HubSpot Program owner

Slack, 2026-10-06
Matt Barge (2:37 PM): Hi @Rachel Goodlad Should Announced campuses have a Book a Call button?
Rachel Goodlad (2:40 PM): Yes, they should all have their own links
Matt Barge (to the website agent): put that into the website playbook and update all the campus locations that are relevant.
